verdict: PROCEED. 61 claims verified off fetched pages. The contact is real and decoded, not pattern-invented. courtney@talkeetnaair.com stays REJECTED. The spine of the study is fully page-verified.
HARD_GUARDRAILS: THE AUGUST 4 2018 FATAL THUNDER MOUNTAIN CRASH MUST NOT APPEAR ANYWHERE, IN ANY DIRECTION, in the study, the demo or the email. No page attributing it to any operator could be opened. Five candidate URLs all returned 404 or 503.
NO REVIEW CONTENT AND NO REVIEW COUNT is usable. TripAdvisor and Yelp 403'd and Birdeye was never fetched. No customer quote may be used.
The TripAdvisor 'weather complaints' theme is KILLED ENTIRELY. It is an unsourced characterisation of a named business.
DO NOT say 'every named leader's contact link resolves to one inbox'. Say 'the team page publishes no individual staff addresses'.
DO NOT claim FareHarbor runs on four of five competitor sites. Only the target's own FareHarbor rail is verified, plus Sheldon's published online booking.
DO NOT claim the absence of AI across all five operator sites. Say 'we checked and did not find' and name the three actually checked: talkeetnaair.com, flyk2.com, sheldonairservice.com.
The glacier is 'Tokositna - West', NOT East.
DO NOT cite the Wikipedia fleet composition or a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan. The company's own fleet page is authoritative.
DO NOT assert what booking software runs behind the counter today. Takeflite is a 2019 vendor blog and the live button points at FareHarbor.
DO NOT use the '35 tours a day' figure, the 2,577 review figure, the corporation number, or the CoolWorks hiring dates. None were fetched.

The 7:30 am to 6:30 pm hours line is scoped to a summer and shoulder window through September 30th, NOT to the same May 1 to September 15 season as the other two. Do not imply one season for all three.
counterweights_to_carry_for_balance: The company holds one of only FOUR federal Denali glacier landing concessions, awarded by the National Park Service for 2020 to 2029.
Its published refund posture is unconditional at 100 percent, which is more generous than either published competitor policy.

drift_pattern: YES, and it is the most important finding in this file. Seven of the rejections lean the same direction, toward making this operator look more primitive, more inconsistent and more troubled than its own fetched pages support. The family band radio 'quote' was a paraphrase tightened into something more manual-sounding than the real sentence. The office hours contradiction was pinned on the flightseeing FAQ when the 9 PM line actually sits on a helicopter FAQ page. The Tokositna glacier was renamed. A '35 tours a day' figure and a 2,577-review figure were carried forward from pages nobody opened. Worst of all, an unverifiable TripAdvisor 'weather complaints' theme was written up as a pain with a source_url pointing at a page that returned 403, and a fatal crash that killed five people was assigned to a competitor with HIGH confidence on the strength of sources that will not load. The individual errors are small. The direction is not. Downstream rooms must treat every unquoted characterisation in the research package as suspect and cite ONLY verified_claims.
